topic: Reviewing Finnish box data fix for recalc
summary_markdown: Someone shared an updated dataset (STAGE) containing a corrected Finnish box. The purpose was to determine if this fix should be applied further to the night recalculation process. [p1] requested clarification on which box was being discussed, confirming it as CC_FL_21012. After reviewing the data, [p1] noted that they could not see the expected peaks in either the production or stage datasets. However, [p1] concluded that the initial impression of the fix was acceptable and suggested that someone else (Настя) review the details.
decisions: The corrected Finnish box data (CC_FL_21012) is ready for potential application to the night recalculation.
action_items: [p1] needs someone else to perform a detailed review of the fix.
